payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how counterfactual data augmentation affects gender bias in predictions and performance, specifically in Neural Relation Extraction systems.

claims.text: Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) mitigates contextual biases by equalizing the contexts for masculine and feminine words in training data, improving model performance and reducing gender bias.
Using gender-swapping and debiased embeddings as part of CDA significantly increases model performance and reduces gender bias in predictions.
CDA helps to address discrepancies in model performance between genders, leading to fairer outcomes in applications that utilize these models.
